[CONTRIBUTING] | ## Screenshots _TODO_ ## Prerequisites - `python >=3.7` ### JupyterLab compatibility | `jupyterlab` | `ipyforcegraph` | special concerns | | ------------ | --------------- | ---------------- | | | | | ## Install `ipyforcegraph` is distributed on [conda-forge] and [PyPI]. ### `ipyforcegraph` with `conda` (recommended) ```bash conda install -c conda-forge ipyforcegraph jupyterlab=3 ``` ### `ipyforcegraph` with `pip` install `nodejs` with a [package manager][package-manager] ```bash pip install ipyforcegraph jupyterlab=3 ``` ### Developing See [CONTRIBUTING] for a development install. ## How it works _TODO_ ## Uninstall ```bash pip uninstall ipyforcegraph ``` ## Open Source This work is licensed under the [BSD-3-Clause License][license].
